design.seed_derivation: first four SHA256 bytes (big endian) of 'NBO-R15-confirmatory-stream-v1/'+str(i), modulo 2**31, i=0,...,15
design.seed_scope: Complete, prospectively declared finite uniform distribution over deterministic complete algorithm streams; all 16 enumerated. No inference to arbitrary unseen initialization laws.

initial_state_population.weights: uniform over nine profiles as in R12

design.primitive_scope: Same capital economy and action box; high-volatility parameter regime. R14 original-regime evidence is retained separately. Every simulator, transfer constant, imported module alias, and checkpoint must receive this dictionary.

training.budget_unit: cumulative independent reference-occupation states; no assertion of equal floating-point or simulator work across methods
training.reference_policy: cell-average analytical schedule M_k/h; frozen for all three stages
training.occupation_time_law: uniform over global decision nodes k=0,...,63, one state per independent clipped-innovation reference trajectory
training.postdecision_time_input: after-decision date t_(k+1); state input is pre-noise postdecision mean x_k

critic_lbfgs.counting: max_iter and max_eval are optimizer settings; finish the current line search and record every actual closure, derivative, and accepted iteration

training.update_scope: Each listed stage count is additional; model weights and replay continue across stages. Adam spatial/time optimizers restart per NBO evaluation block; actor and HJB optimizer states continue.
training.hjb_objective: product of two conditionally independent Hutchinson residual estimates; four total Hessian probes per collocation batch
training.critic_architecture: known lift plus (T-t_after)*(time_MLP_16_16 + spatial_MLP_32_32/d); Tanh hidden layers, zero output initialization; postdecision for NBO, original full-value lift for neural_hjb
training.nbo_spatial_objective: full-replay d-scaled costate Sobolev MSE; no value-level gradients update spatial parameters
training.nbo_time_objective: value MSE updates the time-only intercept with the fitted spatial residual held fixed
training.actor_loss: identical reference-postdecision Hamiltonian linearization for NBO and raw_costate; NBO uses learned q, raw_costate the same four-antithetic mean targets; all labels reusable
training.raw_costate_noise_reduction: antithetic4; every member rollout charged; known terminal-noise control variate has zero average adjustment for paired antithetic costates
training.direct_policy_objective: four-antithetic complete 64-cell transformed-payoff gradient from population initial states; all simulator/backward work counted
training.randomness: SHA256 domain-separated complete streams for initialization, occupation, training innovations, optimization, online checks and independent confirmation
training.fine_grid_scope: trained64-cell scalar critic is a fixed predictor on audit2048 dates; measured bridge error includes all training-to-audit discretization discrepancy, without a zero-bias claim
training.pilot_scope: scratch exploratory pilots selected this design before the protocol/source freeze; their states, parameters and outcomes are not confirmatory observations

stopping.rule: Pause and perform the actual fresh-bank check at each registered checkpoint; stop training if its lower endpoint is at least 0.0005. Return final feasible policy if never attained; return schedule on failure. Charge every attempted check and all initialization/I/O/final confirmation.
stopping.secondary_scope: 0.001 is a final attainment endpoint, not a separately executed early-stopping frontier.
stopping.bank_rule: New domain-separated online bank at each checkpoint, independent of all previous training/validation/checks. Independent final bank after all selection/stopping.

confirmation.replicates: One independent final confirmation array per returned method/seed/dimension; no pooling of stopping arrays.

estimands.method_gain: Uniform average over all 16 streams of continuous-economy payoff minus analytical schedule payoff.
estimands.method_contrast: Uniform average over all 16 paired streams of NBO payoff minus comparator payoff; common schedule cancels pathwise.
estimands.per_seed_gain_and_contrast: Conditional policy endpoints for each registered complete stream.
estimands.attainment_probability: Exact fraction in the finite uniform method distribution; bounds follow from simultaneous per-seed endpoints.
estimands.method_work: Complete observed work distribution over all streams on the declared environment. Failed targets remain unattained; no successful-only median.

inference.online_stopping_event_count_formula: 2 dimensions * 4 methods * 16 streams * 3 checkpoints * 1 path look; each event is two-sided
inference.method_confirmation_event_count_formula: 2 dimensions * (4 schedule gains + 3 NBO direct contrasts) * (16 per-seed intervals + 1 finite-method mean); each event is two-sided
inference.empirical_bernstein: Maurer-Pontil (2009), Theorem 11 (independent, possibly nonidentically distributed bounded variables); two-sided margin uses log(4/event_alpha).
inference.method_mean_rule: Clip each stratum at its proved bound, pool equal-sized independent strata, use maximum range and average transfer/tail allowances.
inference.cross_seed_common_noise_rule: If cross-seed noise is reused, average across seeds within each independent path block; sample size is N, not 16N. Default implementation rejects reuse.
inference.historical_statement_scope: R14 historical 0.05 confidence event is separate; no claim that all historical and R15 endpoints hold jointly at 0.05.
inference.unused_alpha: No recycling of skipped checkpoint/failed-fit events.
inference.secondary_decisions: Thresholds, fee transformations, equivalence and superiority use existing registered endpoints and spend no additional alpha.

economic_decision.otherwise: Unresolved unless the interval establishes material inferiority. Nonsignificance is not equivalence.
economic_decision.margin_scope: Prespecified numerical/economic tolerance in payoff units in this stylized economy; no empirical calibration claim.

failure_policy.training_failure: Deploy analytical schedule; retain failed fit and all consumed work.
failure_policy.missing_seed: Invalid complete-method dataset; cannot silently drop or replace.
failure_policy.check_failure: Retain failure and consumed work; do not certify target attainment.
failure_policy.final_evaluation_failure: Report missing certificate and fail publication completeness; never substitute successful seeds.

work_accounting.timer: Parent clock from before fresh worker process launch through durable final evidence files.
work_accounting.median_rule: Unattained runs have infinite work-to-target; represent unattained median with null plus status. Also report restricted mean at declared cap.
work_accounting.precision_scope: Counters are work proxies, not exact FLOP equivalence.

freeze_gate: All training hyperparameters and three checkpoint budgets fixed.
Exactly one confirmation path count and mesh fixed.
Worker, baselines, inference, protocol, environment manifest and source commit frozen.
No confirmatory outcome inspected before source/protocol freeze.
Every complete-stream run and failure retained.

reporting.decomposition_scope: Descriptive observed finite-step paired payoff components only. Verify the pathwise total identity. No separate continuous-time component interval or causal attribution. The total payoff certificate remains authoritative.
reporting.failure_disclosure: Every seed, method, training failure, target failure and final verification failure retained; missing confirmation cannot silently be replaced.

freeze_scope: Design and numerical source fixed before any main confirmatory outcome; the source Git commit is recorded externally by the execution manifest.
